findings.evidence: Line 03 returns true when the client-controlled header req.headers['x-admin'] equals 'yes'; nothing validates the header against an authenticated claim.
invoiceQuery (lines 10-12) builds the SQL by string concatenation of tenantId and invoiceId with no parameterization, escaping or input validation.
webhookOk (lines 05-08) compares only signature.slice(0, 8) of the expected HMAC-SHA256 digest with startsWith — 32 bits of entropy, non-constant-time comparison.
overLimit (lines 14-16) returns requestCount > 6; with the common convention that requestCount includes the current request, the sixth request is not blocked (6 > 6 is false).
